issues.resolution: Overview now uses four decision-oriented metrics and moves Quick Actions above the operational panels.
The attention feed renders at most five authoritative records with explicit owner/action labels and contextual navigation.
Raw status tokens are normalized in the UI, and recent activity now includes human-readable action/resource context and actor names when available.
The redesign still needs a fresh staging walkthrough of every admin section, controlled mutations, RBAC/IDOR, responsive/accessibility, and request-health evidence.
